Metadata.Title: Uncharted: Drake's Fortune Remastered
Metadata.Name: Uncharted: Drake's Fortune - 1440p (PS4 Pro mode)
Metadata.Note: 2560x1440 output and render in PS4 Pro (NEO) mode. Enable only one Uncharted 1 resolution. The collection starts in Uncharted 1, which sets PS4 Pro mode for Uncharted 2 and 3: to play them, also enable their entry of the same resolution. Requires NEO Enabler.
Metadata.Author: gasb07
